title: ieee80211: update IE HT Capabilities to final 802.11n amendment
description:
Update to the dissection of IE HT Capabilities (tag 45) following 802.11-2020 (9.4.2.55), which include 802.11n amendment.
The main changes are the following:
* The field "MPDU Density" is replaced by "Minimum MPDU Start Spacing"
* The fields "HT Delayed Block ACK", "HT PSMP Support" and "HT L-SIG TXOP Protection support", "Transmitter supports PCO" and "Time needed to transition between 20MHz and 40MHz" fields are removed
* Some renaming of fields to match their name in the standard

**Sample capture**

[ht_capa.pcap](/uploads/b15a437aa4a10988307c2784273003b6/ht_capa.pcap)

**Screenshot before**
![ht_capa_before](/uploads/38bec8f45555c309670ea5a877f69188/ht_capa_before.png)

**Screenshot after**
![ht_capa_after](/uploads/c2462f2a18283e2c10cee7e8c3272c50/ht_capa_after.png)
